title: TAP OIDC Client Secret
description: Schema for an OIDC client-credential secret consumed by a tap_auth provider (req-tap-auth-providers / req-tap-auth-google-oidc). The file reuses the established tap-cares '*.secret.json' envelope (scope/key/kind/description/data — spec-tap-cares-secrets), which tap-cares validates structurally; tap_auth owns this kind-specific schema for the 'oidc_client' data block (client_id/client_secret) since tap-cares deliberately does not validate kind-specific data. The secret is bind-mounted under TAP_SECRETS_ROOT, gitignored ('*.secret.json'), and resolved by scope:key through the tap-cares secret registry — never embedded in a boot profile or DB row. A provider config references this secret by its key; resolve_secrets() validates the loaded data against this schema in the provider's offline self-test.

scope.description: tap-cares secret registry scope. Fixed to 'auth' for tap_auth provider secrets so they are namespaced apart from collector secrets.

key.description: Local key within the 'auth' scope. MUST equal the file basename (<key>.secret.json) AND the provider 'id' that references this secret (e.g. 'example-google'). Stable natural key, lowercase with hyphens.

kind.description: Consumer-defined secret kind. Fixed to 'oidc_client' — selects this schema for the 'data' block.

description.description: Free-form operator note: what this secret is, which provider/IdP it belongs to, and why it exists (mandatory — every secret explains itself).

data.description: The OIDC client credentials issued by the IdP (for Google: Google Cloud Console > Credentials > OAuth 2.0 Client ID, type 'Web application'). Secret material — never logged in full; the client_secret is redacted in all logs.

client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client identifier (e.g. '...apps.googleusercontent.com'). Not itself secret, but stored alongside the secret for atomic provisioning.

client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret (e.g. 'GOCSPX-...'). Highly sensitive; resolved into allauth settings in memory only, never persisted to a DB row or boot profile and redacted in logs.

metadata.description: Optional non-secret operator metadata for diagnostics (e.g. GCP project id, rotation date). Never secret material.
